coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed every named infection, transmission route, defence, vaccine, drug-development stage, monoclonal application and plant response. Added resistance selection, evidence quality and the specific-binding test mechanism. Rejected absolute claims that vaccines stop all infection, antibiotics never harm host cells, all viruses lack treatment, or monoclonal targeting has no side effects. Kept existing careful disease and trial comparisons.
